system.description: Invoking the Secret Name, covers the thaumaturge or a Touched target with an invisible pall. Applies external penalty of (successes ÷ 2, min 1) against sensory effects that would inform an observer of the target's Backgrounds, Intimacies, Motivation, relationships, or intentions. Hinders Read Motivation and similar powers. Celestial Exalted scrying powers add Essence extra dice against this ward.
